channel.title: Versions
channel.description: This is version 2.0. The home page exists in every version, so the version switcher leads to the home page of each.

item.title: Stable
item.description: Exists under this path in every version. The switcher leads to stable in 1.0 and 3.0.

item.title: Moved
item.description: Moved here from moved-a in 1.0 and on to moved-c in 3.0. The switcher leads to moved-a in 1.0 by the alias of this page and to moved-c in 3.0 by the alias of that page.

item.title: Guide: Install
item.description: The first half of guide in 1.0 and the one naming it as an alias. The switcher leads to guide in 1.0 and to guide-install in 3.0.

item.title: Guide: Usage
item.description: The second half of guide in 1.0, without an alias. The switcher leads to the home page of 1.0 and to guide-usage in 3.0.

item.title: Tab
item.description: Merged into tabs in 3.0, which names this path as an alias. The switcher leads to tab in 1.0 and to tabs in 3.0.

item.title: Tabs
item.description: Exists under this path in every version. The switcher leads to tabs in 1.0 and 3.0.

item.title: Renamed
item.description: Renamed from renamed-old in 1.0, without an alias in this version. The switcher leads to the home page of 1.0 and to renamed-new in 3.0.
